semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: The temporal anchor for the financial report section, specifically identifying the date 'March 31 2025'. The comma (B000934) is structurally bound to this date as a punctuation delimiter within the header line, effectively acting as an alias representation of the complete date-token sequence in the parser's view.
semanticNodes.organizationalFunction: Establishes the specific reporting period end-date for the 'CONDENSED QUARTERLY FINANCIAL STATEMENTS' that immediately follow. It serves as the primary temporal identifier for the dataset.
